name: Bank statement inputs reject negative values
description:
Objective: Bank statement inputs reject negative values.
Preconditions: Open Calculator with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Calculator.
2. Bank statement inputs reject negative values.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
